access_token = login_resp['access_token']

resp_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
content = resp_note['content']
old = '[x] Taking a solo backpacking trip'
new = '[ ] Taking a solo backpacking trip'

new_content = content.replace(old, new)
print('old_present', old in content)
print('new_present_after', new in new_content)

update_resp = apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token, content=new_content)
print('update_resp', update_resp)

# Verify
verify_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
print('verify_old_present', old in verify_note['content'])
print('verify_new_present', new in verify_note['content'])
